name: La Plata Museum
scope: The neoclassical exterior of La Plata Museum during the 1912 Holland expedition, with its six-column entrance, raised rotunda, curved gallery wings and original courtyard configuration.

externalReferences.title: To the River Plate and back
externalReferences.publicationTitle: To the River Plate and back; the narrative of a scientific mission to South America
externalReferences.publicationPublisher: New York and London, G.P. Putnam's sons

originalReview.notes: Inspected the original title and copyright leaves and the halftone plate facing printed page 114. The plate shows the portico, terrace steps, flanking galleries and curved ends before the 1920s library addition.

review.method: Original public-domain 1913 book plate after Qualla-first rights review
review.notes: The Qualla exterior matches the native atlas scan. The scan has an unknown photographer and the cited atlas edition has no confirmed publication date. Use Holland’s 1913 published original for the photographed 1912 building.
